name: Bedok North West
summary: West of Bedok North toward Kaki Bukit / Bedok Reservoir — DTL/EWL optionality with heartland texture and community-sport catchment.
body: Bedok North West is the shortlist when heartland texture and dual-line optionality matter more than CBD skyline premiums. The pocket sits west of Bedok North toward Kaki Bukit / Bedok Reservoir edges; housing mixes HDB-dominant stock with selective mid-age condos. Expats land here for car-light hops to Tampines / Paya Lebar and ActiveSG catchment without Marina Bay rents. Watch-outs: estate genset testing calendars, weekday industrial-edge noise toward Kaki Bukit, and confusing Bedok North vs Bedok North West shortlists. Compare with Kembangan Fringe for quieter EWL living, Guillemard East for denser central-east, and Kaki Bukit Fringe when DTL industrial edges win.
